items.title: Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots
items.summary: Nous Research has shipped Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, its MIT-licensed open source agent. Bot Mode replaces the single-agent session list with a roster of named bots. Each bot is a real Hermes profile, with its own chat, memory, skills, and pinned model. It is now bundled and default-on in Hermes Desktop. The post Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Nous Research 已經為 Hermes Agent 提供了 Bot 模式，Hermes Agent 是其 MIT 許可的開源代理。機器人模式用指定機器人名冊取代單代理會話列表。每個機器人都是真正的 Hermes 個人資料，具有自己的聊天、記憶、技能和固定模型。它現在已捆綁並在 Hermes Desktop 中預設開啟。 Nous Research 為 Hermes Agent 提供 Bot 模式，將 Agent 配置檔案轉化為命名機器人名冊，該文章首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items.summary: ByteDance Seed and Tsinghua AIR have released CUDA Agent, an agentic reinforcement learning system that trains a large language model to write GPU kernels that beat a compiler. The gap it targets is narrow but stubborn: frontier models already produce correct CUDA, they just produce slow CUDA. items.title: MiniMax Releases MiniMax-Music3: An Open-Weights Music Model Generating Complete Five-Minute Songs From Lyrics and a Structured Caption
items.summary: MiniMax released MiniMax-Music3, an open-weights text-to-music model. Given lyrics with section tags and a structured caption, it generates a complete song of up to five minutes in a single pass, as 32 kHz, 16-bit stereo WAV. Here is the architecture, the three serving paths, and the license conditions that matter before you ship. The post MiniMax Releases MiniMax-Music3: An Open-Weights Music Model Generating Complete Five-Minute Songs From Lyrics and a Structured Caption appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: MiniMax 釋出了 MiniMax-Music3，一個開放權重的文字轉音樂模型。給定帶有部分標籤和結構化標題的歌詞，它可以一次性生成一首長達五分鐘的完整歌曲，格式為 32 kHz、16 位立體聲 WAV。以下是發貨前重要的架構、三個服務路徑以及許可條件。 MiniMax 釋出了 MiniMax-Music3：一種根據歌詞和結構化字幕生成完整五分鐘歌曲的開放權重音樂模型，該文章首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items.title: OpenAI signs record Ohio data center lease with Nvidia backing up to $105 billion
items.summary: OpenAI has signed a 20-year lease for an 8-gigawatt data center in Ohio. Nvidia is guaranteeing up to $105 billion for the residual value of the facilities and becomes the exclusive chip supplier. According to the Wall Street Journal, nine tech companies now hold around $3 trillion in AI commitments that don't appear on any balance sheet. The article OpenAI signs record Ohio data center lease with Nvidia backing up to $105 billion appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 已簽署俄亥俄州一座 8 吉瓦資料中心的 20 年租約。 Nvidia 為這些設施的剩餘價值提供高達 1050 億美元的保證，併成為獨家晶片供應商。據《華爾街日報》報道，九家科技公司目前持有約 3 萬億美元的人工智慧承諾，但這些承諾並未出現在任何資產負債表上。文章 OpenAI 與 Nvidia 簽訂了創紀錄的俄亥俄州資料中心租賃合同，金額高達 1050 億美元，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start
items.summary: AI production companies like Promise are setting up shop around Hollywood's historic studios, using real-time backgrounds and other AI tools to cut film costs. Netflix already uses AI in 300 of its 1,000 titles, and the startup Higgsfield now carries a $5.4 billion valuation. What was once a tech demo has grown into its own industry, complete with valuations, job titles, and fights over who gets a cut. The article AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 像 Promise 這樣的人工智慧製作公司正在好萊塢歷史悠久的工作室周圍設立工作室，使用實時背景和其他人工智慧工具來削減電影成本。 Netflix 已在其 1,000 部作品中的 300 部中使用了人工智慧，初創公司 Higgsfield 目前估值為 54 億美元。曾經的技術演示已經發展成為自己的行業，包括估值、職位頭銜以及對誰能獲得提成的爭論。 《AI 影片市場已從 Sora's 錯誤開始中反彈》一文首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: Anthropic explains how Claude’s invisible text watermarks will work
items.summary: Anthropic has clarified how it's planning to apply invisible watermarks to Claude-generated text in order to comply with Europe's AI transparency rules. On Friday, Anthropic announced that Claude's text marking system is "a version of the SynthID-Text approach" - an open-source watermarking technology developed by Google DeepMind that creates detectable patterns using wording probabilities. items.title: Google允許用戶去除AI生成影音內容的浮水印、開源函式庫Credentio
items.summary: Google宣佈將讓使用者自行決定以Gemini生成的圖片、影片和音樂移除明顯的浮水印，但仍然保有機器可辨識的數位痕跡。Google同時開源用以開發內容驗證的C++函式庫Credentio。 使用者可在「設定」區中關閉「Show watermark（顯示浮水印）」設定，就能為所有Gemini模型生成的圖片、影片和音樂關閉可見的浮水印，但是人眼不可見的SynthID浮水印和C2PA meta仍然會保留嵌入於背景。Google將在未來幾天內部署這項新設定。

items.title: Stripe is reportedly acquiring AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion
items.summary: According to Bloomberg, Stripe is acquiring the AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion, up from a latest valuation of $1.3 billion. OpenRouter offers access to over 400 AI models, has eight million users, and its CEO had described the company as "Stripe for AI." Now that's becoming a reality. The article Stripe is reportedly acquiring AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 據彭博社報道，Stripe 將以超過 70 億美元的價格收購人工智慧初創公司 OpenRouter，高於最新估值 13 億美元。 OpenRouter 提供對 400 多種 AI 模型的訪問，擁有 800 萬使用者，其執行長將該公司描述為“AI 的 Stripe”。現在這正在成為現實。據報道，Stripe 將以超過 70 億美元的價格收購人工智慧初創公司 OpenRouter 的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
items.summary: Qwen 3.8 27B scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index That's the same score as GPT-5.6 Luna (max), and just one point behind GLM-5.2 (max) and DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 (max) - that GLM is 753B and that DeepSeek is 1.6B parameters, and Luna is size unknown but presumably a whole lot bigger than 27B. Qwen 3.8 27B is a truly astonishing model . Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , qwen , ai-in-china , artificial-analysis

items.title: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility
items.summary: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility Excellent piece of reporting from 404 Media. For a while now there have been stories of book dealers receiving orders for large volumes of books from apparently price-insensitive anonymous customers, widely suspected to be companies looking to scan them for AI training (see my previous coverage of Anthropic's book scanning from June 2025.) 404 Media investigated with an AirTag! In July, one bookseller told me they received a very large order of around 1,000 books on Biblio, one of these marketplaces. The seller agreed to put an Apple AirTag provided by 404 Media in one of the books included in this order so we could see where the book was going. And by extension, which company, AI or otherwise, was behind this massive order. The book ended up delivered to the VGT3 corner of the LAS8 Amazon facility in the north east of Las Vegas, where the entrance carried this on-the-nose logo of a dinosaur with a book! Photo credit: 404 Media Online forum discussions between Amazon workers confirmed that VGT3 destructively scans large volumes of books. Tags: amazon , journalism , ai , training-data , ai-ethics , 404-media
items.summary_zh: 我們追蹤了一批善本書籍。結束於 亞馬遜 AI 培訓設施 404 Media 的精彩報道。一段時間以來，有一些故事稱，書商從顯然對價格不敏感的匿名客戶那裡收到了大量書籍的訂單，人們普遍懷疑這些公司希望掃描這些書籍進行人工智慧培訓（請參閱我之前從 2025 年 6 月開始對 Anthropic's 書籍掃描的報道。）404 Media 使用 AirTag 進行了調查！ 7 月，一位書商告訴我，他們在 Biblio（這些市場之一）上收到了大約 1,000 本書的大訂單。賣家同意將 404 Media 提供的 蘋果 AirTag 放入此訂單中包含的一本書中，以便我們可以瞭解該書的去向。進一步來說，是哪家公司（無論是人工智慧還是其他公司）支援了這一鉅額訂單。這本書最終被送到了拉斯維加斯東北部 LAS8 亞馬遜 設施的 VGT3 角落，那裡的入口處有一個恐龍和一本書的鼻子標誌！圖片來源：404 Media Online 論壇 亞馬遜 工作人員之間的討論證實，VGT3 會破壞性掃描大量書籍。標籤：亞馬遜、新聞、人工智慧、培訓資料、人工智慧倫理、404媒體

items_ai.title: Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots
items_ai.summary: Nous Research has shipped Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, its MIT-licensed open source agent. Bot Mode replaces the single-agent session list with a roster of named bots. Each bot is a real Hermes profile, with its own chat, memory, skills, and pinned model. It is now bundled and default-on in Hermes Desktop. The post Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Nous Research 已經為 Hermes Agent 提供了 Bot 模式，Hermes Agent 是其 MIT 許可的開源代理。機器人模式用指定機器人名冊取代單代理會話列表。每個機器人都是真正的 Hermes 個人資料，具有自己的聊天、記憶、技能和固定模型。它現在已捆綁並在 Hermes Desktop 中預設開啟。 Nous Research 為 Hermes Agent 提供 Bot 模式，將 Agent 配置檔案轉化為命名機器人名冊，該文章首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_ai.title: Google允許用戶去除AI生成影音內容的浮水印、開源函式庫Credentio
items_ai.summary: Google宣佈將讓使用者自行決定以Gemini生成的圖片、影片和音樂移除明顯的浮水印，但仍然保有機器可辨識的數位痕跡。Google同時開源用以開發內容驗證的C++函式庫Credentio。 使用者可在「設定」區中關閉「Show watermark（顯示浮水印）」設定，就能為所有Gemini模型生成的圖片、影片和音樂關閉可見的浮水印，但是人眼不可見的SynthID浮水印和C2PA meta仍然會保留嵌入於背景。Google將在未來幾天內部署這項新設定。

items_ai.summary: According to Bloomberg, Stripe is acquiring the AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion, up from a latest valuation of $1.3 billion. The article Stripe is reportedly acquiring AI startup OpenRouter for more than $7 billion appeared first on The Decoder .

items_ai.title: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility
items_ai.summary: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility Excellent piece of reporting from 404 Media. For a while now there have been stories of book dealers receiving orders for large volumes of books from apparently price-insensitive anonymous customers, widely suspected to be companies looking to scan them for AI training (see my previous coverage of Anthropic's book scanning from June 2025.) 404 Media investigated with an AirTag! In July, one bookseller told me they received a very large order of around 1,000 books on Biblio, one of these marketplaces. The seller agreed to put an Apple AirTag provided by 404 Media in one of the books included in this order so we could see where the book was going. And by extension, which company, AI or otherwise, was behind this massive order. The book ended up delivered to the VGT3 corner of the LAS8 Amazon facility in the north east of Las Vegas, where the entrance carried this on-the-nose logo of a dinosaur with a book! Photo credit: 404 Media Online forum discussions between Amazon workers confirmed that VGT3 destructively scans large volumes of books. Tags: amazon , journalism , ai , training-data , ai-ethics , 404-media
items_ai.summary_zh: 我們追蹤了一批善本書籍。結束於 亞馬遜 AI 培訓設施 404 Media 的精彩報道。一段時間以來，有一些故事稱，書商從顯然對價格不敏感的匿名客戶那裡收到了大量書籍的訂單，人們普遍懷疑這些公司希望掃描這些書籍進行人工智慧培訓（請參閱我之前從 2025 年 6 月開始對 Anthropic's 書籍掃描的報道。）404 Media 使用 AirTag 進行了調查！ 7 月，一位書商告訴我，他們在 Biblio（這些市場之一）上收到了大約 1,000 本書的大訂單。賣家同意將 404 Media 提供的 蘋果 AirTag 放入此訂單中包含的一本書中，以便我們可以瞭解該書的去向。進一步來說，是哪家公司（無論是人工智慧還是其他公司）支援了這一鉅額訂單。這本書最終被送到了拉斯維加斯東北部 LAS8 亞馬遜 設施的 VGT3 角落，那裡的入口處有一個恐龍和一本書的鼻子標誌！圖片來源：404 Media Online 論壇 亞馬遜 工作人員之間的討論證實，VGT3 會破壞性掃描大量書籍。標籤：亞馬遜、新聞、人工智慧、培訓資料、人工智慧倫理、404媒體
